A water supply fitting failed in the service room during the evening. Water damaged the floor finish and a

Avery Vale
SITE
21 Fictional Lane, service room
Observed conditions
At 18:20 the facilities officer found standing water next to the supply cabinet. The floor covering was wet along
the north wall. No injuries were reported.
Immediate response
The officer closed the isolation valve, placed warning signs at the entrance, and moved stored materials away
from the wet area. A repair contractor attended the following morning.
Cause and follow up
A split flexible supply hose was visible behind the cabinet. Retain the damaged fitting for inspection and record
moisture readings before reinstating the floor.

result.summary: This document is a property damage claim reference (CL-9587) from Marble Kite Mutual, filed by policyholder Parker Quinn. It describes a loss event where a water supply fitting failed, causing water damage to a floor finish and a storage cabinet. The policyholder is requesting reimbursement for documented repair expenses, with an estimated loss of $5,468.00. Supporting reports are mentioned as being attached separately.

An incident report (IR-9590) from the Silver Loom Facilities team details the discovery of standing water next to a supply cabinet and wet floor covering on the north wall at 18:20. No injuries were reported. The immediate response involved closing an isolation valve, placing warning signs, and moving materials. The cause was identified as a split flexible supply hose, and the damaged fitting was retained for inspection and moisture readings before the floor was reinstated.

This document is a repair estimate (EST-9593) from Juniper Works Restoration for Morgan Wren, detailing proposed work to remove a damaged floor finish, dry the substrate, and replace panels, along with associated estimated costs and conditions for acceptance.

This document is an invoice from Cobalt Harbor Services to Orchid Field for equipment restoration and inspection services totaling $703.00, issued on September 22, 2026. It details the services performed and payment terms.
This is a fictional invoice from Marble Kite Services to Cedar Bay for equipment restoration and inspection and travel, totaling $952.00, issued on September 25, 2026, with payment terms of Net 30.

This is a correspondence from the Silver Loom Claims desk to Casey Rowan regarding supporting documents for claim CL-9602. The letter acknowledges receipt of the initial loss statement and contractor records and informs the policyholder about the next steps, including retaining damaged materials and sending additional photographs if found.
